title: greed
body:
for anything
and everything
there is such a thing as too much of a thing.
the last spoonful of mush at the
bottom of a bowl that spurs the
avalanche in your stomach.
the fleeting minutes of sleep you force down
your alarm's throat until you break its vocal
cords and wonder,
why it's silent when you need it most.
the extra force you use to crush the
accelerator and prove you're the matador of
the asphalt only to be the bull yourself
charging through the railing so tauntingly
dangled in front of you.

a little too much of anything is a bad thing.
it's best you leave a little left
over when you can,
because what is the joy of that last bite,
if you suffer for it?
